acceptance_criteria.verbatim: Positive: `uv run pytest tests/integration/test_justify.py tests/unit/test_justify_rules.py -q` green with every done-when case named in the test ids; `uv run cairn justify --statement <hash>` prints the derived tag and justifying evidence hash, `--json` one document with `schema_version`, and an unknown hash exits 1.

Planted negative: statistical→PROVEN must be a LatticeViolation; missing or failed repro must cap at CONJECTURE; forged verdict digest must not yield PROVEN; a coverage gap must be a CoverageViolation; an all-`author_supplied` producer must be capped; a waiver record must move no tag. Any of these returning a positive class fails the bead.
No-Claim: all evidence is synthetic; no ladder, Lean artifact or real verdict exists at M0; the Tier-2/3 branches (KEEP_IN_SAMPLE scope, hunt records) are exercised by construction only.

MR-W, MR-A, MR-M, MR-C and MR-W∘MR-A in `tests/unit/test_justify_properties.py` green at ≥ 500 examples; every mutant in `tests/mutants/justify_mutants.py` (`comparator_strict_containment`, `comparator_checks_lo_only`, `comparator_assumptions_superset`, `derive_takes_last_node`, `kind_table_off_by_one`, `producer_rule_ignores_range`) killed — a survivor fails the bead; the comparator never raises unhandled on 500 arbitrary interval records.

The kind → max-class table and the §13 done-when cases are each one parametrized test (the done-when case ids are the `ids=`), all built from `tests/factories.py`; `tag_history` counts land in `test.log.jsonl` via `db_snapshot`.

Done when: every bullet above has been re-executed at close, with the exact command and its raw output pasted in the close comment and bound to the commit SHA that produced it; a bullet without pasted output is not done.
Evidence cites file:line for each touched source and test file in the close comment, so the compliance audit can re-run it without reading the session.
